rubric.criterion: React Compiler is enabled for application source through the supported Vite integration.
The locally installed compiler and build integration dependencies match the installed Vite React plugin generation.
The Vite 6 configuration uses reactCompilerPreset with the Rolldown Babel integration instead of the removed inline Babel option.
The implementation runs the existing build check and leaves a direct way to verify compiler output.
The change does not add manual memoization, compiler opt-outs, or an unrelated lint and formatting stack.
